open_questions_for_vendor: Please confirm the exact legal entity that contracts with Tavus for WebRTC infrastructure services — full legal name, legal form, and state/country of incorporation (we believe 'Daily, Inc.') — and provide your registered office / principal place of business address (your public pages state only that the founding team is based in San Francisco).

Have you designated a representative in the EU under Article 27 GDPR (and in the UK under UK GDPR)? If yes, please provide the representative's name and full address; if no, please state the basis on which Art. 27 is considered inapplicable.

Have you formally appointed a Data Protection Officer? Your GDPR page references a 'Data Privacy Manager' — if that person (or a DPO) is formally designated, please provide their name and telephone number and/or email; if not, please confirm that help@daily.co is the authoritative contact entitled to respond to data-protection-related requests from customers and their customers (SAP requires a named channel).

Please provide your current SOC 2 Type II report (period covered, Trust Service Criteria in scope) under NDA so Tavus can place it on file (our records show no report on file in Vanta yet). Please also clarify whether Daily itself holds an ISO 27001 certificate for its ISMS (your pages cite an audit by Dansa D'Arata Soucia LLP) or whether the ISO 27001 reference applies only to the AWS data centers hosting your service — if Daily holds a certificate, please provide it with the scope statement.

What minimum TLS version (e.g. TLS 1.2, TLS 1.3) is enforced for signaling, REST API, and dashboard endpoints? Your pages state '256-bit TLS' and HTTPS-only but do not publish a protocol-version floor.

Please confirm the encryption-at-rest algorithm and key length for each category of stored data in your service: call recordings stored on Daily-managed storage, stored chat data (your pages state AES-256), transcripts, and logs/metadata.
Are backups encrypted, and with which algorithm?
Who generates and manages the encryption keys for data at rest (platform-managed AWS KMS, customer-specific keys, CMEK/BYOK options)? Are keys customer-specific or shared?
Can Daily, acting as a processor, anonymize and/or pseudonymize personal data (call metadata, transcripts, recordings, logs) on the customer's instruction?

For the EU region / geofencing capability: does confining a call to the EU region (e.g. eu-central-1 Frankfurt) keep ALL processing in-region — signaling, TURN/SFU media relay, recording processing, transcription, logs, and API metadata — or only the media plane? Where are dashboard/account data and logs stored?

Please provide your current sub-processor list for the video/WebRTC service (https://www.daily.co/legal/sub-processors/ could not be retrieved) — SAP requires the processing chain to Level 2, e.g. the underlying cloud provider(s) and any transcription/recording vendors.
Please confirm your EU-US Data Privacy Framework and Swiss-US DPF certification status (registry entry name) so it can be cited as a transfer mechanism alongside SCCs in the DPA.
